item.title: Akeso shares plummet as Chinese firm’s cancer drug ivonescimab faces FDA setback
item.description: Shares in Hong Kong-listed Akeso plunged as much as 31.8 per cent on Monday morning after the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) rejected its cancer drug application, raising investor worries over the company’s near-term commercial outlook. Ivonescimab, one of the most closely watched innovative drugs emerging from China, did not establish “substantial evidence of effectiveness”, said US firm Summit Therapeutics, which has the exclusive rights to develop and commercialise the drug in global...

item.title: Houthis advance on Yemen government stronghold of Aden
item.description: Yemen’s Houthis were advancing on the interim seat of the internationally recognised government on Sunday, positioned just 60km from Aden, sources told Agence France-Presse, as government forces rushed to defend the city. Four military sources within government forces and two government sources said the Houthis had seized control of two districts in Lahj province and were moving towards Aden. They said the Houthis were positioned at the Al-Kharaz camp in Al-Madariba, 60km (about 40 miles) from...

item.title: South Korea cracks down on online ‘exam pill’ sales ahead of national college exam
item.description: South Korea’s drug safety agency has flagged 571 online posts illegally selling or promoting prescription drugs under misleading labels such as “study-enhancing drugs” and “exam pills” – warning students and parents against buying medication from unverified sources ahead of Thursday’s national college entrance exam, or Suneung.
